authority: Local preparation only; server stopped; no live execution approved
capability: Connect frozen-input admission, native model fingerprint/package checks, local tokenizer construction, owned serving startup and the fixed native batch under one parent deadline
safety_checks: Default invocation emits a plan without accessing a server or model
Pinned specification and separate execute option required; hashes are audit references, not human permission
Current model content and package checks occur before server creation
Occupied local endpoint or GPU compute process causes refusal
New server inherits the owned worker process group; parent requests group cleanup after exit or timeout
Incomplete batch returns nonzero worker exit, not process success
Failure records and exclusive output paths retained without retries

approved_local_rerun.scope: Mocked process/server/model gates plus local source copies and synthetic SQLite fixture; no network or inference

remaining_live_gates: Fresh user approval of a particular available server, balance, rate, bounded batch and output directory
Current-host native configuration must be pinned; no old host identity assumed
Actual Linux lifecycle, inherited descendant groups, startup readiness and 32768-window GPU capacity are not established by mocked tests
Per-request provider token parity, complete raw responses and off-host backup must be verified after any separately approved run
Any startup or batch failure is retained; no silent resizing, new seeds or restart
scientific_interpretation: Engineering readiness only. No causal cache effect, method gain or independent replication has been demonstrated by these checks. Two exposed development targets are not a confirmatory dataset.
